wybie_line_a.text: Oh, let me guess. You're from Texas or Utah. Someplace dried out and barren, right?
I heard about water witching before, but it doesn't make sense. I mean, it's just an ordinary branch.
Ow! And I don't like being stalked, not by psycho nerds or their cats!
He's not really my cat. He's kind of feral. You know, wild.
Of course I do feed him every night, and sometimes he'll come in my window and bring me little dead things.

wybie_line_b.text: Look what I found in grandma's trunk.
Well, great to meet a Michigan water witch.
But I'd wear gloves next time.
Cuz that dowsing rod of yours, uhm...

other_mother_intro.text: What are you doing here in the middle of the night?
You're just in time for supper, dear.
Now go tell your other father that supper's ready.

other_father_dinners_ready.text: I am sorry but she said to tell you the foods ready.
Mmm, who's starving? Raise your hand.

other_father_golden_chicken_breast.text: We give our thanks and ask to bless our mother's golden chicken breast.

other_parents_waiting.text: We've been waiting for you, Coraline.
Yep, wasn't the same here without you, kiddo.

other_mother_visit_again.text: It's time for bedtime, dear, but promise you'll visit us again every night.
And I'll have special treats ready for you.

other_mother_supper_1.text: Well here comes the gravy train

other_mother_supper_2.text: Another roll, sweet peas, corn on the cob.

other_father_song.text: Make it up a song about Coraline. She's a peach, she's a doll, she's a pal of mine. She's as cute as a button in the eyes of everyone who ever laid their eyes on Coraline.
When she comes around exploring home and I will never ever make it boring, our eyes will be on Coraline.

dad_death.text: No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no!
